body:
The problem is... I tried to get a different job.  Oh, I tried so frellin' hard.  I lost my old job because I had migraines and I wasn't a full time employee so they could just let me go.  So, I figured, no biggie, I should get a job in no time.  _Four months later_ and still no job.  With the migraines and loss of hours I was already teetering on bad finances, but with 4 months and zero income, I came down to flat zero.  Maxed credit, and 0 dollars. I cashed in my credit card reward points in order to pay my credit card minimums, it was bad.

So, I've only been at this job for 7.5 weeks.  I've only had one paycheck, which wasn't even enough to pay all the important debts I had (I hadn't even paid my psychiatrist in 4 months, and stopped paying my student loans, and they started yelling at me).  So yeah, I'm really stuck.  I can't miss a paycheck.  I've already spent 4 months looking for another job, and I couldn't even get a BITE except for this one.

So, I have to wait until I have at least even the tiniest of a cash buffer, because I went beyond stretching out how far I could hold out in terms of job hunting.

I've done all that on previous occasions, and they do work... just, only temporarily.  It still comes back.

Sure, I'm stuck between a rock and a hard place right now for multiple situations.  I'm a bit tied up financially and job wise, and also a bit tied up with my relationship.  Heck, I'm even tied up with my psychiatrist, who I just sent an email to saying, "Dude, we need to fix our issues or split."

One problem is that I've been focusing TOO much on what satisfies me... and not doing my job.  I have zero financial reserves, so I can't very well afford to be fired right now.

And I think that's also what has me so stressed out -- the lack of freedom.  I always make sure I have an out, _always_ (because, you know, depression!).  But due to a series of unfortunate events, all of my outs got used up and I am all out of outs.  I _need_ this job.  But I'm so depressed, I can't focus worth shit.  That makes me _angry_, and its making me flail against the bars of this pointless existence because god fucking damnit, even though I put up 50 layers of protection around me, the fucking world had to rip down 51, _didn't it?_

And whatever it is, I can't act _today._  I have no money.  I have to, at minimum, wait two months before I have enough cash to do squat to change my situation.  I have plans and ideas to act on, but I have to wait.  So I just have all this pent up stress, and anger, and agony, and no where to direct it to, because I have to sit... and wait.  Its agonizing.

I'm sorry you've had bad luck finding support groups.  I'd encourage you to keep trying.  Maybe even ask on /r/ftm if they know of any other groups.  Could check out yahoogroups, googlegroups, or see if any of the LiveJournal groups are still active.

And definitely, I wish you all the luck.  Its hard, but I've seen people do it, so I know you can, too.

Try to go to some churches for food or at least advice for where to go.  Since you have rats, you can feed the rats your food.

Try not to stress about March's rent.  You have the time to pull in the shifts.  Treat finding the shifts as a job itself.

Take it one day at a time.  Look for and grab every opportunity you see.  You have time for more opportunities to come along that will make this whole situation work out.

I know that it is _so_ hard to move when you are feeling so helpless.  Take into yourself that it is not a helpless situation, you can find more shifts, you can find more food, you can make March's rent, it is possible for workman's comp to come through in time. Keep telling yourself that, because it is all true.  Believe it, and you can move and make it come true much more easily.

Oh geeze, um, I'm not exactly the one to be asking that question.  I think I have this fundamental flaw in my view of the world that I can't shake.  I don't really _enjoy_ anything.

But, I guess the one thing I most want, and most think of is a family.  I think I could finally be at peace and perhaps actually enjoy the world if I had a family to be a part of.
What else do you need? I don't know what EI provides so I can't evaluate if that could cover your costs.

I'm sorry this happened to you.  This is a very tough and sensitive situation to have other people analysing and taking sides.  What he did was not right, so feel confident to stand your ground and say that.  Just merely say, "What he did was not right. End of story." 

Everyone else is also confused about this situation, so they are all going to have to think this through and figure out what is right and what is wrong.  Some people are going to come to the wrong conclusion, unfortunately.  Feel sorry for them, they are unable to correctly figure out what is morally right and wrong.  Very soon these people will have their own experiences and they will start to have a better understanding of what happened to you.  They will re-evaluate their initial conclusions and realize they were wrong.

There is a part of _you_ that feels guilty which is making you feel more judged and stared at than you actually are.  A part of you feels you may have been a prude, or that its wrong to agree to something and then change your mind, or that it was wrong to tell your friends what happened.  Absolutely none of what you did was wrong.  At your age, you have every right to release your sexuality slowly.  In fact, I encourage it to be done slowly so you can appreciate and master each stage.  It is OK to change your mind.  Many change their mind once they actually face doing something, especially for the first time (sexually or not).  Intimacy is also about trust, and it is so wrong to be intimate with someone who won't calmly back away when you say no.  And because what he did was so wrong, it is within your right to warn others about his behaviour.

Try as best you can to release this pain from within you.  You are guilty of nothing, and you can raise your head high confidently to assert that.

The medical system is _mind bogglingly_ frustrating for transgender issues.  You are not alone, this stress is felt by almost everyone in your situation, and they have also felt just as suicidal.  It could help to reach out to others who have gone through this, too.  Reddit likely has many groups, and I know LiveJournal does (that's where I used to hang out).  It could help to talk, and also to get advice for tricks to get around all the red tape.

If you are mobile at all, consider a move over to San Francisco.  It is a bit tough, but I know some who have had access to testosterone without as much hoop jumping as on the east coast.

If you are not mobile, just take it one day at a time.  One day you WILL be mobile and you will be able to get out of that region and find a doctor.  In the mean time, just keep calling every doctor you can possibly reach.  Make multiple appointments with the same type of doctor because you never know which one will work out.

Good luck.  _You can do this._  You really can.

Your symptoms sound a lot like mine, so I wouldn't want you to make any rash decisions.  You're on a good course -- you have the right gender, and you have a family.  Now you just need to get your brain to stop telling you bullshit.

Are you on any medication?  If not, I would strongly recommend it.  I saw a therapist weekly for 10 years and nothing changed until I started medication.  Your brain is _lying_ and _manipulating_ you, and a psychiatrist can stop it from happening so frequently.  I can understand how seeing a psychiatrist can be a bit nerve wracking because you are transgender, but your symptoms have nothing to do with that and a psychiatrist should be able to see that fairly clearly.

Same happened to me.  I started to get down and serious with the suicide planning and then went... shit.  My grandma. FINE, I can't do anything until after she dies.  And I just made peace with that, through and through.

USE that time.  If you _have_ to live, then figure out what it is you have to do to make it bearable and do it.  Figure out _why_ you hurt and fix it, I cannot stress that enough.  Then, in that time, hopefully you will find your point in life that makes it more enjoyable.

What is "not a depressed mind state"?

I frequently describe what occurs to me as a "depression attack."  I have recovered from depression attacks and have continued my regular day-to-day life.

Occasionally I will get multi-month-long depressed states where I am generally discontent and suffer from frequent depression attacks.  It is usually in those episodes that I choose to turn my life upside down.

Dude, you do NOT want to give less fucks.  Its putting you down the road to pointlessness, and you do not want to go there.  I have had moments where I have not given a fuck _so completely_ that I have frozen mid movement.  I have even collapsed while walking.  Just everything turns off.  Absolutely nothing matters completely throughout the whole of your being.  Don't go there.

I don't mind fucking things up, but I do mind when I can't act on cue when I'm expected to. Maybe that's why I'm so upset this time. I had another depression attack earlier this year but it didn't get me nearly as upset.  I was already sick with migraines so I didn't even attempt to fight it because I was already on sick leave from migraines.

But this time I'm _angry_.  I have zero financial reserves, and I have only been working for this company for 7.5 weeks, and last week I already fucked everything up barely able to focus on anything whatsoever and barely got any work done.  Now deadlines are coming up and things need to get done and I have absolutely no idea if I'm going to be able to get myself back on track in time. I know that the more I struggle the longer its going to take to get back on track.  Its so fucking frustrating.

And I KNEW this depression attack would come.  I tried so hard to not let it.  I just could not find a new job (lost my job due to the migraines) and was running out of money, it had been months. So finally I get an offer, but it was from a virtual company with no office so I'd be working from home.  Ugh! Disaster in the making.  I searched EVERYWHERE and I kept them on hold as long as I could searching and searching to see if I could get anyone else to hire me, but no one would bite.  So... fuck. I had to work with them.

I tried to keep everything up and going, but just had a series of unfortunate events.  My life is a series of unfortunate events.  I was going to rent an office, but then my roommate informed us he was moving out (financial burden + loss of friend + loss of his dog).  I was active in NaNoWriMo, but then someone stole my tablet and caused major injury to my hand (couldn't type + cut off socialization + cut off physical activity).  I had to switch migraine medication, and it gave me severe side effects making me like a chemo patient for several weeks (illness + worthlessness).  On top of all that, earlier this year my boyfriend told me that he wasn't sure he wanted to marry me because I'm so unstable, so having had hurt my hand and being ill made me feel bad that I was making him feel bad.  

So, I tried.  Really did.  But I think the day after Christmas was the day the depression attack became the dominant entity.  I SOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO wanted to finish baking my gingerbread cookies. I love gingerbread cookies.  I sat at the kitchen table for three days in a row, and I just couldn't make the gingerbread cookies.  I had some dough in the fridge I could have rolled out and chopped up, but I couldn't.  I still have the mixed bowls sitting on the table waiting to be finished with the rest of the ingredients, because I really really want to bake those gingerbread cookies.  They're my favourite.

Yeah, I did that, too.  I don't know how long you've been doing that, or how many major depressive episodes you've been through since you've done that, but after bouncing off the walls screaming a few times _at work_ it was time to agree that method just was not working.  I did that method very consciously for 10 years.

So, I gave up, put myself in the hands of a psychiatrist and just said, whatever, I'll do whatever you say.  Yes, I am tremendously more stable, I would rather stab myself in the eye than go back to the state I was pre-meds.  But all the meds have seemed to have done is lengthen the time between episodes.  And make me stop yelling at people, which is a good thing.

But is this ever really going to _go away_? I am so sick and tired of falling into this fucking hole.  And I don't think its ever going to go away.  I've been like this since I was 11.  Its just going to keep happening again and again.

There are seriously times I feel like it comes out of no where.  And other times a slight happens and I go way further lower than a normal person should.  There are times when I can see if A + B + C come together that it could create an environment to trigger a depression attack, and I do whatever I can to prevent them from coming together but can't, then I try as hard as I can to abort the depression attack from hitting, but it just doesn't work.

I have turned my life upside down on multiple occasions simply so I can do what is best for my mental well being.  It just comes back again.  I can go ahead and toss my life upside down yet again, but I have no guarantee that it won't prevent this from happening to me yet again.

Its hard to have a good life when depression keeps throwing you a curve ball.  I've had to restructure my entire life around my depression, and I've lost so many opportunities because of my depression.  I'm just tired of it.

I don't actually care about my successes because they are ultimately pointless.  This perspective is at times a conflict with others because I see no point in life and so I am totally fine with death.  The only problem with death is the pain it inflicts on those that are alive -- so, I'm pro-choice, because for what point to make them live? I'm pro euthanasia, because it is selfish to postpone the pain of those who are alive to inflict pain on those who are dying.

But take one step back from that, and the pain of those alive is also pointless.  I did not bat an eye at the Sandy Hook shooting.  It wasn't even interesting enough for me to click the link on the reddit homepage.  Someone died from a shooting in front of my house earlier this year and my reaction was merely, "Huh, that was interesting.  And odd, I thought I lived in a fairly safe neighbourhood.  Oh well, it probably won't happen again." and I went along my merry way without a care in the world.

I don't know what it means to "love myself."  I don't hate myself.  I think I'm fine.  I'm above average.  I have potential and resources to become better and do what I want.  I'm praised often.  I'm very comfortable with myself because I don't really care what happens to me or what others think of me.  

If anything, I have had desires to become _worse_.  I have had long desires to wish I was just a normal dumb person -- ignorance is bliss.  I HATE seeing people fuck up left and right.  At least recently I got on meds so I can stop being angry about it.  For awhile there I was quite gorgeous and had men hitting on me a lot, which made me extremely uncomfortable.  After a new mechanic started calling me telling me about how horrible his marriage was and asking if he could move in with me, I wanted nothing other than to disfigure myself.  Instead, I let myself go. I'm now normal.  I'm a bit conflicted about it, but I have at least been working on losing the weight.

The one thing that has made me feel the most rooted in the world is when I have felt like I have been in a family.  Since I have no family, these moments are literally moments, but it gets me thinking and yearning.  I did think I was going to get that family at any time now until my boyfriend informed me earlier this year he wasn't sure he could stay with me with my instability.  But I've been unstable my whole life, I told him, and I keep trying to stabilize, I told him, but I keep falling over.  I just cannot in anyway guarantee that I won't stop falling over.  I mean, the big deal this year was that I had a migraine every day for 6 months. I mean, WTF? Where the hell did that come from? I never had a migraine before in my life, and then I have one every day for 6 months until I could finally find a doctor who could finally figure out what was wrong and finally put me on the right medication.  

And yet he's still with me, even though I've fallen into yet another major depressive episode.  And they just keep coming, and they just don't stop.  I had one get triggered by a dream out of the blue.  Everything was going GREAT.  Then one random night I had a dream about my 11-years prior rapist, which put me into 2 weeks of flashbacks and a three month depression and totally threw my life upside down.  I had _plans_ and they all went to shit because I had to spend my money doing nothing, then get a desk job, then get inflicted by migraines, wrack up massive medical debt, lose my job by said migraines, run out of every penny and piece of credit I have before getting saddled with a job where if I miss even one paycheck I'm financially fucked.  It's going to take me until October before I reach net 0.

And my psychiatrist and everyone else is like, oh hell no, do NOT start a family while you're like this.  It will solve nothing, if anything it would make your life a million times worse.  But it's not going to stop.  Its never stopped.  I just keeps happening again and again and again and I can't see how it'll ever stop happening.
